data.name: Rugba Leeg
data.detailed_description:
Train the house down. Cook the books. Don't get thrown into a tree. This is Rugba Leeg.

Deep Rugby League Simulation

A fully authoritative match engine modeling real-time rugby league second-by-second. Manage dynamic fatigue, tackle pressure, organic support play, injuries, foul play, and absolute loose units. Every second counts—because every second is simulated.

State-of-the-Art Graphics

Exceptionally [i]previous-generation[/i] graphics powered by the year 1996. Featuring dynamic crowds that respond to the action, a full weather system affecting match play, and afternoon, twilight, or night matches.

Front-Office Control

Take command (and responsibility) of a Rugba Leeg franchise. Control training, develop a squad, negotiate with player agents, sign sponsors, and upgrade your stadium. Walk the tightrope between competitive dominance and club integrity. Manage salary cap audits, balance sponsor expectations, and survive league investigations.

Immersive Medical & Judiciary

Protect your squad with a persistent career injury ledger, including head injury tracking, concussion management, and graded judiciary hearings.

How far will you go to win it all?

Every off-field scandal leaves a permanent mark on your squad's legacy. Balance player morale against team discipline as you manage arrests, contract wars, and internal politics. Keep the players happy to maintain the support of the locker room, or enforce strict standards to protect your team's on-field performance.

Clubs, Facilities, & Influence

Upgrade your facilities to appease players and supporters alike. Don't believe the rules apply to you? They don't have to. Build your [b]Tactical Influence[/b] with Leeg HQ to lobby for rule changes, appease demanding board members, and secure crucial financial bailouts.

Rugba Leeg. Coming soon.

Build a dynasty, navigate player scandals, survive salary cap audits, and lobby League HQ to change the rules as your tactical influence grows. This is Rugba Leeg.
